Small gatherings, massive crowds, neighbors and friends. Today, once more, we took to the streets to make our voices heard. In America, we have no kings. In America, the power of the people is greater than the people in power.

Thank you, St. Louis for your energy and your powerful love for each other, and for our country.

The cost of youth sports has gotten out of control.

Parents are getting squeezed. Kids are feeling the weight.

We cannot allow it to become a luxury good available only to those with means.

What an incredible inspiration and testament to what is possible when we reject cynicism and despair, and instead choose hope and determination.

Video

It's time to end this reckless war and start fighting for Americans here at home—affordable healthcare, childcare, lower energy bills, cheaper groceries, and more money in your pocket.

That’s the fight I want to have.

I've had enough.

My colleagues and I are using every lever of power we have to force this debate in the Senate.

Hegseth and others need to face the American people and answer questions under oath. No more stonewalling.

For Trump and Republicans in Congress, there's always money for war—but never money for you.

And now gas prices are spiking, adding to families' struggles.

In response, one of Trump's top economic policy advisors went on TV and made it very clear: they simply don't care.
